subject: Registry Layer Caching Add-on renewal and runbook
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Voss <sara.voss@registrylayer.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthis Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Registry Layer Cache Add-on renewal — initial ask

Hi Sara,

Our current subscription for RegistryLayer’s Layered Cache add-on is up for renewal on 2026-07-15. Can you send an updated quote and the change log for the v2 billing model you mentioned on the last call? Two items we need in the quote:

- Explicit per-repo + per-host pricing (our usage profile has grown ~25% q/q).
- SLA for cache warming latency and cache-hit ratios (we care about tail latency under load).

Also, we need to confirm data retention defaults for cached layers (any PII/extracted metadata implications) and whether retention can be set at org vs repo level — legal will want that.

Attachments: I’ve included our current usage summary (see attached stub) in case it helps.

Can you get something over by EOD Wednesday this week?

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: current_usage_summary.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Sara Voss <sara.voss@registrylayer.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@registrylayer.com
Date: 2026-06-02T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Registry Layer Cache Add-on renewal — initial ask

Hi Laura — thanks for the note and the usage file.

We’ve attached an updated quote (renewal_quote_v2.pdf) that maps your current hosts to our new per-host tiering. Highlights:

- 12-month term: 10% renewal discount off list; 24-month term: 18% discount.
- Includes proactive cache pre-warming for critical repos up to 500GB/month at no extra charge.
- SLA: 99.5% availability for cache service; cache-hit ratio targets are workload-dependent but we guarantee baseline configurations.
- Retention: default is 90 days for cached layers; org-level retention configurable as a paid policy add-on.

We can also provide a migration runbook if you decide to move to the org-level retention model — that will include steps for invalidation and warm-up.

If you want the 12-month commit at the 10% discount, I can send a DocuSign and the standard SOW for signature.

Best,
Sara Voss
Customer Success Manager
RegistryLayer Inc.

Attachments: renewal_quote_v2.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthis Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Registry Layer Cache Add-on renewal — internal ops + legal review

Marissa / Karthik / Dev — forwarding Sara’s reply and the attached quote. Key asks for review:

- Legal: can you validate the retention language + any data handling clauses in the SOW? Sara says cached layers are default-90d and org-level retention is a paid add-on; we need to ensure that aligns with our compliance requirements for customer data.
- Infra/Platform (Karthik / Dev): confirm that the proactive warm-up (500GB/month) effectively covers our busiest service meshes; if not, we should ask for tailored warm-up thresholds.
- Finance: I’ll need a quick check on whether we should prefer 12- vs 24-month from an effective- cost standpoint.

If everyone is ok, plan is to accept the 12-month 10% discount and start the DocuSign flow — that keeps us on the current cadence but gives us the negotiated discount.

Date: 2026-06-07T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Registry Layer Cache Add-on renewal and runbook — approve 12mo

Sara — we reviewed the quote with Legal and Infra. Summary and next steps: 

- We’ll accept the 12-month term with the 10% renewal discount (deal id DL-8342).
- Legal requested two small updates to the SOW retention clause (we asked RegistryLayer to add an explicit org-level override and a 30-day notice period before retention changes). Sara has acknowledged and will update the SOW.
- Infra validated the 500GB proactive warm-up is reasonable; if we see sustained growth we’ll revisit bespoke warm-up tiers in Q4.
- Finance: please process a PO using the attached redwood_po_template.docx and reference DL-8342.

Sara, please send the updated SOW and DocuSign link and we’ll route to Legal + Finance for signature. Thanks — want to keep this tight so we don’t lapse.

Laura

Redwood Inference
